integrity: Complete analytic proof and an independently executable rational arithmetic checker are included. The result has undergone same-model review, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns stationary environmental-state marginals with fixed strategies, not the full coevolving imitation process.
Optimal distributions of group composition may not be feasible on an individual prescribed connected hypergraph or at an individual prescribed finite edge count.
Sensitivity exponents are exactly 1 and 2; no general exponent-pair assertion is made.
Finite exact-rational checks do not replace the analytic proof; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp group-composition envelopes for two-state environmental public-goods games
